description: A cluster of grey spines, hard as nails and about as friendly. Tuskmaul wears a ridge of them.
lore: Nothing about them is a quill. They are the grey spines off the ridge of a [[monsters/gray_brute_2|Tuskmaul]], a hand long, hard enough to pin oak, and the name comes from one man at one fire who split a tip, dipped it, and produced a blot the size of his thumb and a line that gave out after two letters. He has not been allowed to forget it.

He is also the reason four fires on that road can read at all. He taught it evenings, for nothing, badly, for about sixty years, and when he comes in for a drink now somebody always sets an inkpot down in front of him, and he always looks at it, and everybody laughs, himself included and loudest.
Thirty gold the cluster. Joiners buy them, not scribes. Iron weeps in that country and a quill never has.
gm_notes: A running joke at four fires that is also a monument to the man it is about. Good colour for any fire scene needing warmth rather than dread.
